title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Tariff
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Tariff. A tariff is a schedule of rates or charges of a business or a public utility. Tariffs can be based on time, thresholds or consumption; however, combined tariffs may also exist that mix more than one of these types. Root class (no explicit OWL parent other than owl:Thing); not a geo:Feature, so it has no location. This is the base schema for the Tariff family: ConsumptionBasedTariff, ThresholdBasedTariff and TimeBasedTariff all subclass Tariff and repeat these 6 properties plus their own additions. Own properties: appliesTo, hasBillingPeriod, hasDuration, hasPeriod, hasBillingDate, hasStartTimestamp.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Tariff'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

appliesTo.description: Relationship. The water meter to which this tariff applies. Maps to s4watr:appliesTo. Points to a WaterMeter entity.

hasBillingPeriod.description: Property. The billing period of a tariff, as an ISO8601 duration (e.g. 'P1M' for monthly). Maps to s4watr:hasBillingPeriod. Model:'https://schema.org/Duration'.

hasDuration.description: Property. The duration of a tariff, as an ISO8601 duration. Maps to s4watr:hasDuration. Model:'https://schema.org/Duration'.

hasPeriod.description: Property. The period of a tariff, as an ISO8601 duration. Maps to s4watr:hasPeriod. Model:'https://schema.org/Duration'.

hasBillingDate.description: Property. The billing date of a tariff. Maps to s4watr:hasBillingDate.

hasStartTimestamp.description: Property. The start date and time of a tariff. Maps to s4watr:hasStartTimestamp.
